evidence.observation: The speaker reports that a transaction sending funds to the contract was confirmed.
evidence.quote: the transaction is confirmed, so it was sent to the contract.

evidence.observation: The speaker links contract funding to activating the bot through an action control.
evidence.quote: Next thing that we do after it's sent to the contract, we'll just go over here and press. The action button.

evidence.observation: The described bot is said to buy into a project before retail investors.
evidence.quote: Buy into that project, so that way it will front run at the retail investors that come in.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes an automated sale within one minute, with a claimed 90% transfer to the wallet and 10% retained in the protocol.
evidence.quote: It will automatically sell within one minute, and then from there it will take 90%. It will automatically transit it back to your wallet. The remaining 10% will stay within the front running protocol.

evidence.observation: The speaker reports having made several hundred BNB and offers BSCScan transaction reports as corroboration.
evidence.quote: I've made several hundred BNB, which I can show the transaction reports on BSCscan to. Corroborate that.

evidence.observation: The speaker claims that the workflow can produce upwards of 100 BNB a day.
evidence.quote: upwards of 100 BNB a day

evidence.observation: The description presents the contract as automatically buying and selling for profit.
evidence.quote: immediately buy and sell at profit.

evidence.observation: The description states that insufficient funding or high burn fees can cause fees to exceed profit.
evidence.quote: If you fund the contract with 0.4 BNB or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit.

evidence.observation: The description recommends funding the contract with around 0.5 to 1 BNB in relation to the stated fee risk.
evidence.quote: I recommend funding the contract with around 1 - 0.5 BNB just to make sure that won't happen.

evidence.observation: The title promotes the front-running bot with an immediate tenfold-return claim.
evidence.quote: PancakeSwap Front Run Bot (Sniper Bot) - Make x10 INSTANTLY (NO DOWNLOAD)
